mentions.name: AI-powered story game
mentions.description: An AI-powered story game in which multiple agents manage in-game memories, perception, and the unlocking of game achievements. Players can try it via the linked demo.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I quit my job to work to create a story game powered by AI. We have a few agents that are in charge of memories, perception, and unlocking game achievements. If that sounds cool you can give it a try here:
https://k58.duya.io
